build_cnnlstm_model: build a CNNLSTM model that fuses CNN image features with LSTM text features for vision-language tasks
create_cnnlstm_forward_pass: create a forward pass through CNNLSTM that processes image and text inputs to generate answer scores
review_cnnlstm_build: review the CNNLSTM build method that constructs text embedding, LSTM, CNN, and classifier layers
test_cnnlstm_forward: test the CNNLSTM forward method to verify it correctly fuses hidden states and image features
refactor_cnnlstm_classifier: refactor the CNNLSTM classifier layer to dynamically set output dimensions based on answer choices
